# Cartographer declaration header

The upstream Cartographer install omits this internal declaration header.
It is copied unchanged from the compatible zx_carto source used by the
experiments; the original Apache-2.0 notice and LICENSE are preserved.
Runtime implementation is linked from the external Cartographer library.
